notes: QA Dashboard v1.1 — Quality Control (MeasureQuick QA). v1.1 adds ServiceTitan click-through: each Job # in the detail table links to https://goettl_lasvegas.eh.go.servicetitan.com/#/Job/Index/{job.i} where i = ServiceTitan Job ID carried from the export's 'Job ID' column. Renders as plain text when i is absent (graceful degrade). Build script resolves export columns BY HEADER NAME, never by fixed position. Sections by Job Class: H-Demand=Service, H-Maint=Maintenance, H-Misc Service=Callback/Warranty, H-Install+H-Install QC=Install. Install headline = Full Systems only (Package/Split Horizontal/Split Vertical; Mini-Split excluded to Other). Buckets: mini->other, partial->partial, duct->ducts, package|split->full, else other. Tags: MQ-Complete, Vitals A/B/C-F (worst wins), Picture Compliant (install only).
